text:
ashwin: Heads-up — after canary of route-priority v2 we see a transient invoice delta for a subset of tenants. Preview shows tokens missing from final aggregation. Anyone else seeing this?

maria: yup saw alert spikes on preview pipeline, ~2% token drop for long sessions. no clear stack trace yet.

kevin: I think tombstone events from route reassign were getting dropped under ingest backpressure. We introduced a short-lived 'route_swap' tombstone to decrement previous tenant counts.

sophie: wait we added tombstones? that was supposed to help rebalancer idempotency, not billing. we never wired them into the tally consumer.

ashwin: example event emitted in v2: 
```json
{"type":"route_swap","session_id":"s-123","from_tenant":"T1","to_tenant":"T2","delta_tokens":-432}
```

kevin: tally consumer schema filter currently only accepts type in ["usage", "promo_credit"]. route_swap gets filtered at the proxy hop.

mike: proxy filter added earlier to avoid double-counting during flips, but now if tombstones are filtered upstream we never subtract the old tenant's tokens. hence the positive delta on the receiving tenant's invoice preview.

maria: options: (A) emit tombstone as a usage record with negative tokens; (B) update tally consumer to accept route_swap and apply delta; (C) do an offline reconciliation job mapping session_id -> owner and correct counts.

sophie: (B) is the least operationally awkward but touches hotpath. risk of adding branches that increase p99.

kevin: (C) is slower but safer for production throughput; customers may see wrong invoices for hours though.

ashwin: finance already flagged ghost tokens in invoice preview for enterprise tenants. this needs a quick mitigation.

invoice-bot: Automated alert: Invoice-Preview-Delta > 0.5% for tenants tagged 'enterprise' at 2026-03-21T09:12Z.

maria: short-term mitigation: enable sampling fallback in preview service to use clientlib attribution for sessions older than 5m. reduces noise until we fix producer/consumer.

mike: implementation plan proposal: prioritize (B) behind feature flag + metric gating. steps:
- add route_swap branch in tally consumer
- add unit + perf microbench
- deploy consumer canary to 10% traffic
- monitor invoice-preview delta and p99 latency

sophie: also add an e2e test in console preview that simulates route_swap events; otherwise rollout will break the preview tests.

kevin: follow-up: do we need to reingest missing tombstones for affected tenants? i think yes — replay from ingress buffer for window 2026-03-21T08:50Z..09:10Z.

ashwin: I'll own the replay + canary. maria to own consumer change. sophie to add console tests. mike to own rollout runbook + dashboards.

maria: note: consumer config flag name: enable_route_swap_handling. keep schema stable (token_field, session_id, tenant fields).

mike: ack — creating tickets and dashboard panels (invoice_delta, replay_progress, consumer_p99).

ashwin: thanks all. keeping this thread as the rollout notes. ping here if we see >1% sustained delta or any perf regressions.
